title: appointments.appointments.create
description: An appointment is booked against REAL records (appointments#21): the customer, the service and the professional are LINKS to the customers/services/staff modules, not free text. Since appointments#11 the SNAPSHOT (customer name/phone/email, service name/price/duration, professional name) is FROZEN by the handler from the rows the runtime pre-loads through `reads` (customers.get, services.services.get, staff.members.get, staff.services.eligible_for_service); the denormalized fields below are accepted for compatibility with older callers and IGNORED — the browser does not decide who the customer is, what the service costs or who performs it. Since appointments#10 the payload no longer accepts `settings` or `existing_appointments` either: the booking policy and the appointments it could collide with are READ by the runtime (`appointments.settings.get`, `appointments.appointments.conflicting`, `appointments.blocked_times.overlapping`), and a caller that could still name them was a caller that could still hand us `allow_overlapping`.

customer_name.description: Ignored since appointments#11 (kept for older callers): the snapshot comes from the authoritative read.

customer_phone.description: Ignored since appointments#11 (kept for older callers): the snapshot comes from the authoritative read.

customer_email.description: Ignored since appointments#11 (kept for older callers): the snapshot comes from the authoritative read.

service_name.description: Ignored since appointments#11 (kept for older callers): the snapshot comes from the authoritative read.

service_price.description: Ignored since appointments#11 (kept for older callers): the snapshot comes from the authoritative read.

staff_name.description: Ignored since appointments#11 (kept for older callers): the snapshot comes from the authoritative read.

duration_minutes.description: Optional. When omitted, the professional's override, else the service's catalogue duration, else the module default applies.

service.description: Ignored since appointments#11 (kept for older callers): the service row comes from the `services.services.get` read.
